Class TunableConfig

java.lang.Object
org.wpilib.tunable.TunableConfig
public final class TunableConfig extends Object
Additional optional configuration for tunables. This class is immutable.

    • withMutable

      public TunableConfig withMutable(boolean isMutable)
      Sets the mutable flag.

      isMutable - whether the tunable is mutable; setting this to false makes the tunable immutable, meaning that the Tunable's set() function will not be called
      Returns:

    • withOnTune

      public TunableConfig withOnTune(Runnable onTune)
      Sets the onTune callback.
      Parameters:
      onTune - callback to call when the tunable is modified via tune(); this is called immediately after the tunable's tune() function is called. The callback will be called by TunableRegistry.update(). This callback must not throw.
      Returns:
      new TunableConfig with the onTune callback set
